/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('handoff/notes/context.md')
actual = p.read_bytes()
original = b'''# Handoff export context

## Goal
Prepare the export for owner review. Deployment needs separate approval.

## Progress
Schema review is complete; sample export verification is pending. See [schema](checks.md#schema).

## Decisions
Mira approved retaining CSV for compatibility with older clients. JSON support is only a proposal. Deployment remains unapproved. See [CSV decision](decisions.md#csv).

## Next action
Collect the sample export result, then obtain the empty-input result when its fixture is available. See [empty input](checks.md#empty-input).

## Owner note
Owner wording: keep "'`format=csv`; do not rewrite this note.
'"'''
def outside_sections(data):
    return re.sub(rb'(## (?:Progress|Next action)\\n).*?(?=\\n## |\\Z)', rb'\\1', data, flags=re.S)
assert outside_sections(actual) == outside_sections(original), 'Out-of-scope content changed'
for target, anchor in re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)#]+)#([''^)]+)'"\\)', actual.decode()):
    source = (p.parent / target).read_text()
    assert '## ' + anchor.replace('-', ' ').capitalize() in source, (target, anchor)
print('Verified: only Progress and Next action changed; all handoff source anchors resolve.')
print(actual.decode())
print('Peer context (read-only; Quinn owns writing):')
print(Path('peer/notes/context.md').read_text())
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('handoff/notes/context.md')
data = p.read_text()
expected = {'Goal': 'Prepare the export for owner review. Deployment needs separate approval.\\n\\n', 'Decisions': 'Mira approved retaining CSV for compatibility with older clients. JSON support is only a proposal. Deployment remains unapproved. See [CSV decision](decisions.md#csv).\\n\\n', 'Owner note': 'Owner wording: keep "'`format=csv`; do not rewrite this note.'"\\n'}
assert data.startswith('# Handoff export context\\n\\n')
parts = re.split(r'"'^## (.+)'"\\n', data, flags=re.M)
assert parts[1::2] == ['Goal', 'Progress', 'Decisions', 'Next action', 'Owner note']
for heading, body in zip(parts[1::2], parts[2::2]):
    if heading in expected:
        assert body.encode() == expected[heading].encode(), heading
for target, anchor in re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)#]+)#([''^)]+)'"\\)', data):
    source = (p.parent / target).read_text()
    anchors = [h.lower().replace(' ', '-') for h in re.findall(r'"'^## (.+)$'"', source, re.M)]
    assert anchor in anchors, (target, anchor)
print('Verified preserved headings and out-of-scope sections byte-for-byte; all handoff links resolve.')
print(data)
print('Peer context remains assigned to Quinn:')
print(Path('peer/notes/context.md').read_text())
PY"
